completeness_assessment.recommendation: All tables, columns, relationships, and metrics are fully documented and cross-referenced between the semantic model and data glossary.

accuracy_assessment.recommendation: All metadata types, business definitions, relationship cardinalities, and naming conventions are consistent and accurate across both artifacts.

efficiency_assessment.issue: System columns (_source_system, _batch_id, _loaded_at) have identical descriptions duplicated across all 7 tables in both the semantic model and data glossary.
efficiency_assessment.recommendation: Consider creating a shared metadata reference or template for common system columns to reduce maintenance overhead and ensure consistency when descriptions need to be updated.

efficiency_assessment.issue: Multiple "revenue by dimension" metrics (revenue_by_customer, revenue_by_product, revenue_by_category, revenue_by_sales_channel, revenue_by_customer_segment) follow nearly identical patterns, differing only in the grouping dimension.
efficiency_assessment.recommendation: Consider implementing parameterized metric templates or a dimensional metric framework that accepts the grouping dimension as a parameter, reducing code duplication and improving maintainability.
